title: Pyokotan no Dai Meiro localization reverse-engineering
scope: High-resolution CHR atlases for all 16 physical 8 KiB pages
Improved FCEUX runtime trace instrumentation for Mapper 69 PRG/CHR state and PPU writes
Runtime CSV analyzer that estimates physical PRG/CHR offsets where required state was captured

runtime_trace.user_action_needed: Run the script in FCEUX from power-on, capture title/menu/text screens, then run trace_log_analyzer_v2.py on its CSV.

known_limitations: The currently known text dump is partial and consists of known literal text/template records and metadata.
No complete Japanese dialogue encoding or pointer table has been established.
The .tbl's kana mappings are visual candidates and are not runtime confirmed.
No Vietnamese-patched ROM has been generated.
A physical CHR tile index is not automatically a text byte; bank and renderer behavior must be observed.
